links.outcome: Head-to-head accuracy of two LLMs on bone and soft tissue tumor questions versus expert answers
links.effect: DeepSeek outperformed ChatGPT in overall accuracy (74.7% vs 55.4%, p < 0.001); single-choice 86.9% vs 64.9%; Pathology & Genetics 72.5% vs 40.0%; Treatment 71.3% vs 51.2%.
links.quote: DeepSeek outperformed ChatGPT in overall accuracy (74.7% vs 55.4%, p < 0.001), excelling in single-choice questions (86.9% vs 64.9%, p < 0.001) and two key domains: Pathology & Genetics (72.5% vs 40.0%, p = 0.006) and Treatment (71.3% vs 51.2%, p = 0.015).

links.outcome: LLM clinical knowledge accuracy on sarcoma diagnosis, imaging, pathology, staging, and treatment questions
links.effect: Overall accuracy 74.7% (DeepSeek) and 55.4% (ChatGPT); both models shared 51 errors, indicating gaps in clinical knowledge.
links.quote: Cross-model analysis revealed DeepSeek uniquely answered 60 questions correctly where ChatGPT erred, while both models shared 51 errors.

screen.reason: Evaluates the diagnostic accuracy and clinical reasoning of DeepSeek versus ChatGPT using multiple-choice questions and clinician ratings of a complex case, without testing a specific organizational deployment practice or safeguard.
